english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a plant seed or bulk seed, and it is also used metaphorically for the beginning of an idea and technically for a tournament seed or random-generator seed.

examples.english: I bought a packet of seed to plant at home.
examples.traditional: 我買咗包種子返屋企種。
